label: visual-only
vendored_note: Nothing was downloaded or vendored. No third-party code or asset ships.

sources.name: Hillaire 2020, A Scalable and Production Ready Sky and Atmosphere Rendering Technique (EGSR 2020)
sources.used_for: the Rayleigh, Mie and ozone constants in bake_alpine_ap.py
sources.note: typed from memory; the paper was not fetched and the values were not read from the pinned engine build. They must not be described as the engine's defaults or as this project's atmosphere: FFlightSimWorldBeauty::ApplyAtmosphere and FlightSimDustHaze.cpp set the Mie layer per preset and visibility. Only the Rayleigh green value 0.013558 /km has a second witness in the repo (FlightSimDustHaze.cpp DustRayleighGreenPerKm).

sources.name: Henyey & Greenstein 1941 phase function; Rayleigh phase function 3/(16 pi)(1 + cos^2)
sources.used_for: the two phase terms of the proposed shader; both integrate to 1 in the Mac test

sources.name: Narkowicz 2016 ACES filmic fit, x(2.51x+0.03)/(x(2.43x+0.59)+0.14)
sources.licence: published formula (facts); typed from memory, not fetched
sources.used_for: test only: a stand-in filmic curve to size the measurement's tonemap bias on synthetic frames. It is not the engine's tonemapper.

candidates_not_adopted.name: PetrVevoda/pragueskymodel
candidates_not_adopted.why: dataset licence unverified; it is a sky-dome radiance fit, not transmittance and in-scatter to a surface at a given distance

candidates_not_adopted.name: Scroga/Altitude-Responsive-Sky-Model
candidates_not_adopted.why: wraps the Prague dataset, same unverified licence

candidates_not_adopted.name: fgarlin/skytracer
candidates_not_adopted.why: per-aerosol Mie tables would change the atmosphere away from the SkyAtmosphere reference this lane's gate is defined against; not fetched or vetted

candidates_not_adopted.name: AT3D
candidates_not_adopted.why: GPL-3.0 and cloud volumes, not this item

candidates_not_adopted.name: NVIDIA approximate-Mie (draine.hlsl) / Jendersie and d'Eon 2023
candidates_not_adopted.why: cloud and fog droplets; the engine's aerosol phase is Henyey-Greenstein and the gate compares against the engine

repo_facts_checked_on_mac: scripts/run_test_scenarios.py SCENARIOS entry 11 is 'A-4 over the matterhorn, strong wind, severe turbulence' at 5000 m (test asserts it)
webapp/runs.py with_render_switches puts every FLIGHTSIM_RENDER_SWITCHES token on the engine argv; scripts/visual_fix_round.ps1 -Switches sets that variable

FlightSimRenderCommandlet.cpp reads -NoAerialPerspective from the command line and records scene.aerial_perspective_off; FlightSimClouds.cpp ApplyAtmosphere records 'nothing: no visible sky atmosphere' when the atmosphere is hidden
